summary: V5 is archived as a former live research program. Its sidecars and experimental comparison artifacts remain published for auditability beneath the current live release.

v43_handoff.experimental_summary: Shadow score is published. Promotion into the headline model still depends on validation and anchor-review sign-off.

release_thesis: V5 should be the first release that upgrades the science beyond exposure alone: augmentation heterogeneity, empirical mobility, richer uncertainty, and a clearer realized-risk forecast.

formula_family.automation_pressure: Σ_t w_it · exposure_t · success_t · autonomy_t · (1 - bottleneck_t)
formula_family.augmentation_upside: Σ_t w_it · exposure_t · success_t · (1 - autonomy_t) · bottleneck_t

workstreams.label: Augmentation heterogeneity
workstreams.goal: Replace one universal augmentation rule with workflow-sensitive priors informed by empirical productivity studies.
deliverables: Validation note on which occupations move most

workstreams.label: Empirical mobility transitions
workstreams.goal: Move transition support from broad heuristic rankings toward observed occupational pathways and wage/training tradeoffs.

research.title: Exposure to Artificial Intelligence and Occupational Mobility: A Cross-country Analysis

deliverables: Observed wage delta and training duration fields
Transition ranking override when empirical evidence exists

workstreams.label: Posterior uncertainty
workstreams.goal: Upgrade bootstrap intervals into a latent measurement model across the exposure sources and propagate uncertainty through the final score.

research.title: Making AI Count: The Next Measurement Frontier
Anthropic Economic Index: New building blocks for understanding AI use

deliverables: 80/95% intervals on exposure and net risk
Separation of statistical uncertainty from provenance confidence

workstreams.label: Realized-risk forecast
workstreams.goal: Calibrate short-run realized effects separately from structural overlap using adoption and capability evidence.

research.title: The Rapid Adoption of Generative AI
Large Language Models, Small Labor Market Effects
Task-Completion Time Horizons of Frontier AI Models
Labor market impacts of AI: A new measure and early evidence

deliverables: Adoption and capability scalars grounded in literature
Realized-risk proxy distinct from structural and near-term risk
Validation family for short-run labour signals

promotion_gates: Each workstream must ship as an auditable sidecar artifact before it touches the headline model.
Validation families must map cleanly to the construct they are testing: structural, transition, augmentation, or realized risk.
No release should absorb multiple unvalidated constructs into the headline score at once.
